From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pearson-analytics.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pearson — hotel block ops and traveler profile consolidation

Hi Sophie — thanks again for confirming Pearson's headcount for the Oct 12–14 exec workshop. A couple of operational asks from our side so we can finalize the hotel block and payment plan: 

1) Rooming preferences: we have a mix of execs (quiet rooms preferred), two lactation requests, and three attendees with late arrivals (after midnight). I attached a rough CSV with preliminary profiles; please review the highlighted flags.

2) Master bill: Pearson prefers a split bill — Redwood to cover 25 rooms night 1–2, Pearson to cover the rest. Can the hotel provide a single master bill with line-item breakdowns? If not, what doc/proof does Townsend Travel need to apply split charges?

3) Accessibility & dietary touchpoints: please confirm accessible room counts and whether onsite catering can accommodate two kosher + three vegetarian lunches.

Operational timeline: we need the signed block contract and final rooming manifest by EOD Friday (Aug 21) to avoid attrition penalties.

Attachments: pearson_rooming_profiles_v3.csv (draft)

Best —
Marissa Cole
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Pearson — hotel block ops and traveler profile consolidation

Marissa — thanks, received. Quick updates from Pearson's side: 

• Final headcount is 82 rooms across three nights (Oct 11–14 check-out). We confirm the three late arrivals and two lactation needs.
• On billing: Pearson will be the payor for rooms beyond the 25 rooms Redwood covers. Townsend Travel manages the billing on our PO; I copied them to coordinate the split.
• Catering: I confirmed with our internal team — kosher vendor is required for one lunch, plus vegetarian options for the rest.

I'll ask Hilton to send the formal block contract and confirm accessible room inventory. Hannah from Hilton will follow up directly (cc'd).

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Lee
Senior Program Manager, Pearson Analytics
Sophie.Lee@pearson-analytics.com

From: Hannah Gibbons <hannah.gibbons@hiltondowntown.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pearson-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Townsend Travel <bookings@townsendtravel.co>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 14:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Hilton Downtown — block contract and accessibility confirmation

Hi all — following up from our call earlier this week. We attached the signed block contract (Hilton_Block_Contract_PG_signed.pdf) and the rate sheet. Key operational notes: 

• Block: 90 rooms held under Pearson Analytics (cut-off Oct 1). Rooms will release to the public after cut-off with a 10% attrition for guaranteed block.
• Accessible inventory: we can guarantee 6 ADA rooms across floors 6/7. Please mark the two lactation requests so we can reserve adjoining rooms when possible.
• Late arrivals: front desk will hold key cards until 2:00 AM; for arrivals after that we will leave keys at bell desk with signed ID check.
• Master bill: we can issue one consolidated master bill with line-level folios. Townsend Travel will need the PO and billing contact to be listed on page 1 of the master bill PDF.

Attachments: Hilton_Block_Contract_PG_signed.pdf (signed), rate_sheet_Oct2026.pdf

Questions for Redwood ops (Laura / Marissa):
1) Can you confirm the exact 25 room nights Redwood will cover (dates + room types)? We need the room types to pre-assign.
2) For the three late arrivals, do you want late check-in packages (snack + bottled water) added to their rooms? Small fee applies.

Thanks —
Hannah Gibbons
Senior Sales Manager, Hilton Downtown
hannah.gibbons@hiltondowntown.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Gibbons <hannah.gibbons@hiltondowntown.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@pearson-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Townsend Travel <bookings@townsendtravel.co>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pearson — hotel block ops and traveler profile consolidation

Thanks Hannah & Sophie — confirming operational details from Redwood's side so Townsend can finalize PO/billing instructions. Action items below (please highlight completed items in the shared Drive folder):

Redwood commitments (to be reflected on master bill):
- Oct 11 (night 1): 10 king city-view rooms (executive quiet floor)
- Oct 12 (night 2): 15 king city-view rooms
We will cover room rate + tax for those 25 room-nights. Please mark these 25 rooms on the manifest as "Redwood prepay".

Rooming notes & allocations (Pearson + Redwood combined):
- 3 late arrivals: assign to rooms 607, 608, 609; add late check-in package to 608 only (requested by attendee).
- Lactation: reserve rooms 712 & 713 as adjacent queen rooms near elevator.
- Quiet/exec preference: allocate all Redwood guests to floors 9–10 where available; mark them for priority housekeeping after 3pm.

Finance & billing: Townsend Travel — please confirm the PO number and billing contact for Pearson (we need that to generate the master bill with separate folios). If we hit attrition, who is point for dispute?

Attachments: Pearson_MasterBill.xlsx (template) — I've added a sample line for the 25 room-nights.

Next steps and timeline:
- Townsend: confirm PO and billing contact by EOD Aug 21 (today).
- Hannah: confirm room assignments for the two ADA rooms and the lactation adjacency by COB Aug 21.
- Marissa/Vivek: I will collect final traveler names and profiles and upload the manifest by Aug 24.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Events Ops, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0146
